headline: Profit swings positive but eases from year-ago levels
summary_short: Revenue was $1,571.6M, up 27.5% q/q and roughly flat (+1.1%) y/y; diluted EPS of $0.20 reversed a $(0.32) loss last quarter but was down from $0.25 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 27.5% q/q and 1.1% y/y to $1,571.6M. Gross profit of $776.2M was up 29.7% q/q and flat y/y. Operating income of $81.3M gained 20.9% q/q but fell 12.7% y/y. EBITDA of $136.5M swung from a $28.4M q/q loss to a $164.9M improvement, though down 2.6% y/y. Net income of $42.1M reversed a $67.1M prior-quarter loss, down 20.6% y/y. Diluted EPS was $0.20, up $0.52 q/q and down 20.0% y/y from $0.25.
